meta.title: Hall Ion Source
meta.description: Starthermatech provides XHS-HTS low-power Hall ion source complete equipment (~200 W) with anode voltage 150-350 V, supporting Ar/Kr/Xe propellants. Suitable for small-thrust propulsion test benches, beam supply, and materials processing experiments. Supports flange and interface customization for electric propulsion ground testing and research laboratories, with equipment ordering and custom solution consulting.
page.title: Hall Source
page.lead: Low-power Hall source with stable beam for lab, small thrust, and process use.
detail.title: Hall Source (Low-power, ~200 W)
detail.overview: ≈200 W Hall source with cathode, adjustable anode 150–350 V. Xe recommended; Ar/Kr optional. Suited for small thrust tests, bench validation, and beam supply for surface processing.
